description: Mechanics are intentionally marked unsupported until a trusted source, exact rule scope, and regression fixture have been reviewed. This registry is not an executable combat model.

mechanics.label: Attack roll
mechanics.scope: Core baseline arithmetic only; caller supplies effective attack and attack bonus.
limitations: Formula implementation exists, but this registry has not yet been verified against a trusted, versioned OSRS reference.

mechanics.label: Defence roll
mechanics.scope: Core baseline arithmetic only; caller supplies effective defence and defence bonus.
limitations: Formula implementation exists, but this registry has not yet been verified against a trusted, versioned OSRS reference.

mechanics.label: Maximum hit
mechanics.scope: Core baseline arithmetic only; caller supplies effective strength and strength bonus.
limitations: Boosts, prayers, equipment effects, style bonuses, special attacks, and rounding exceptions are outside the current registry scope.

mechanics.label: Attack speed
mechanics.scope: Ticks supplied by a weapon profile or caller; no inferred missing speeds.
limitations: Source coverage and weapon-specific exceptions have not yet been verified in this registry.

mechanics.label: Prayer modifiers
mechanics.scope: No prayer modifier is applied by the current scoped baseline calculator.
limitations: Do not apply prayer multipliers until the rule, rounding order, and relevant styles are source-verified.

mechanics.label: Potion modifiers
mechanics.scope: No potion or temporary boost is applied by the current scoped baseline calculator.
limitations: Boost formulas and rounding order are not modelled.

mechanics.label: Special attacks
mechanics.scope: No special-attack accuracy, damage, energy, or sequence modelling.
limitations: Weapon-specific effects, energy costs, and attack sequences are not modelled.

mechanics.label: Target defence
mechanics.scope: Caller-supplied target defence input only; no target-specific phases or immunities.
limitations: Target stats, defence style, phase changes, immunities, and damage caps require independently sourced evidence.
